The '''''Retribution''''' was a [[Discril-class attack cruiser|''Discril''-class attack cruiser]].

==History==
The ''Retribution'' originally served with the [[Daupherm Systems Fleet]]. However, it was stolen by [[Gorvan Shrulldike]] and [[Evram Darkmere]], who set themselves up as [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. However, Darkmere began to consider slavery to be repugnant, so he defeated Shrulldike in personal combat and took control of the ship.

==Commanders and crew==
The crew of the ''Retribution'' was made up mainly of former members of the [[Daupherm Merchant Space Fleet]]. The [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]] was [[Dexter Thorgrim]], who personally selected most of the candidates to become new crew members of the ship.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Evran Darkmere's ship, the Retribution. One of my favourite ship designs I've come up with.|Mike Jackson|<ref name="DA" />}}
The ''Retribution'' appeared in the [[1994]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' (RPG) supplementary book ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', published by [[West End Games]].<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref> [[Mike Jackson]], who illustrated the ''Retribution'', noted that the design was one of his personal favourites.<ref name="DA">{{DeviantArt|username=steampoweredmikej|url=steampoweredmikej/art/Star-Wars-Darkmere-s-Retribution-343918400|name=[[Mike Jackson]]|text=Star Wars &ndash; Darkmere's Retribution|quote=Evran Darkmere's ship, the Retribution. One of my favourite ship designs I've come up with.}}</ref>
